latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of android-remote-control.

- Control Android devices remotely using uiautomator2 via ADB.
- Capture device screenshots, simulate touch events, and launch apps remotely.
- Supports basic commands: snap (screenshot), click (simulate tap), and start (open app).
- Includes instructions for device connection and usage examples.
